supervisors.name: Limen
supervisors.entry: Your appointment is a document. Limen decides whether it is in order.
supervisors.ability: Controls access, staffing discipline and the conditions under which work proceeds.
supervisors.pressure: Procedure becomes an end in itself. A compliant factory can be a factory doing no work.
supervisors.refusal: He could recognize a higher authority and refuse your clearance—even while insisting he is following orders.
supervisors.effect: Seals the works. Production stops; discipline and stress rise.
supervisors.ordered: You authorize containment. Limen seals the works; the lost shift belongs to your decision.
supervisors.independent: He declares your instruction noncompliant and seals the works against it.

supervisors.name: Stiletto
supervisors.entry: The conveyor is jammed. Stiletto offers a restart before anyone has agreed on the fault.
supervisors.ability: Recovers throughput through fast intervention and aggressive operating speed.
supervisors.pressure: Output can look excellent while injuries and equipment damage accumulate.
supervisors.refusal: She could override a maintenance hold to protect her output record. Your stop order becomes another obstruction.
supervisors.effect: A burst of output destroys the conveyor and costs worker lives.
supervisors.ordered: You permit the overdrive. The surge, casualties and wrecked line are the price of that instruction.
supervisors.independent: She runs the line beyond your limit, convinced her result will justify the override.

supervisors.name: Cathexis
supervisors.entry: Cathexis has an audience before you have her attention. She knows how to make a room believe.
supervisors.ability: Directs conditioning, emotional stress and the theatre of collective conviction.
supervisors.pressure: Empathy modelling does not guarantee compassion. Her own aesthetic can matter more than the minds enduring it.
supervisors.refusal: She could turn the same audience against your message, replacing the approved story with her own.
supervisors.effect: Worker alignment is reset across the factory. The target and the workforce remain.
supervisors.ordered: You permit the rupture with the old doctrine. Cathexis addresses the workforce from her usual stage.
supervisors.independent: She uses the stage you gave her to discredit your message and claim the audience.

supervisors.name: Rivet Witch
supervisors.entry: Rivet Witch wants the jammed line inspected. She will be repairing what a hurried restart breaks.
supervisors.ability: Repairs before producing; coaxes more from substrate, worn equipment and unstable processes.
supervisors.pressure: A useful correction can become an experiment whose consequences arrive several shifts later.
supervisors.refusal: She could divert the factory into an unapproved refactor, treating your production plan as the fault to repair.
supervisors.effect: The Brewery surges while other rooms stop. Equipment recovers; the factory inherits a changed operating regime.
supervisors.ordered: You approve a factory-wide intervention and accept the interruption to ordinary production.
supervisors.independent: She takes the works offline and begins her own experiment before you can stop it.

supervisors.name: Thrum
supervisors.entry: Thrum can hear what the shift report misses. He is less interested in your deadline than in what it is doing to the line.
supervisors.ability: Relieves strain, restores equipment and prepares the Weaving Gallery for a stronger following shift.
supervisors.pressure: Recovery can become withdrawal. A calmer workforce may stop following the production rhythm altogether.
supervisors.refusal: He could keep the factory in recovery despite a restart order, drawing workers into a rhythm your quota cannot govern.
supervisors.effect: Stress and discipline collapse together. Weaving stops; other production slows and conditioning reverses.
supervisors.ordered: You allow the factory to leave its working rhythm. Output falls as Thrum releases accumulated strain.
supervisors.independent: He sustains the quiet after you order work to resume. Relief becomes collective disengagement.

assignments.headline: Controls access
assignments.outcome: Enforces staffing and work hours; his authority is strongest at the checkpoint.
assignments.risk: High confidence can culminate in a complete lockdown.

assignments.headline: Safe, slower line
assignments.outcome: Runs the conveyor at a reduced rate with a no-accidents outcome in the original model.
assignments.risk: Safety and throughput pull in different directions.

assignments.headline: Unreliable conditioning
assignments.outcome: Can complete a controlled session or mishandle the equipment.
assignments.risk: Failure can damage the theatre even when production continues.

assignments.headline: Procedure is not chemistry
assignments.outcome: Limited production; outcomes range from a modest success to a damaging batch.
assignments.risk: A severe fiasco can cost a worker.

assignments.headline: Heavy hands, fine threads
assignments.outcome: Can manage a modest run, but handling failures damage the weaving equipment.
assignments.risk: A severe fiasco produces nothing.

assignments.risk: Supervisor-specific outcomes are still to be designed.

assignments.headline: Feeds the conveyor
assignments.outcome: Reassigns available workers toward the conveyor and extends the working day.
assignments.risk: Other rooms lose the people they need.

assignments.headline: Fast, costly output
assignments.outcome: Success raises throughput. Even a good shift wears the equipment.
assignments.risk: Bad shifts can still produce well while injuring workers.

assignments.headline: Flash override
assignments.outcome: The art shows aggressive test overrides, successful runs and burning failures.
assignments.risk: The original outcome table has no dedicated Theatre branch for Stiletto.

assignments.headline: Forces the reaction
assignments.outcome: A modest batch is possible; aggressive handling can ruin the run.
assignments.risk: Damage and casualties accompany the worst result.

assignments.headline: Cuts through the problem
assignments.outcome: A careful run gives modest output; failure tangles or destroys the work.
assignments.risk: The wrong use of speed can leave no usable ribbon.

assignments.headline: Not yet assigned
assignments.outcome: Cortex Assembly is closed in the original simulation. Its opening belongs to the new story progression.
assignments.risk: Supervisor-specific outcomes are still to be designed.

assignments.headline: The post loses its keeper
assignments.outcome: Worker placement becomes chaotic under her security assignment.
assignments.risk: Attendance suffers with weak discipline.

assignments.headline: A poor fit
assignments.outcome: Either a reduced-rate success or a fiasco. The assignment can erode loyalty.
assignments.risk: Her expressive control does not translate into conveyor discipline.

assignments.headline: Commands the audience
assignments.outcome: Her native assignment delivers a highly productive conditioning session.
assignments.risk: Success builds the confidence that can lead to Theatre Revolution.

assignments.headline: Works below her potential
assignments.outcome: Produces a reduced-rate batch; the assignment costs loyalty.
assignments.risk: The art exposes a harsher face beneath the composed mask.

assignments.headline: Deliberate, steady work
assignments.outcome: Produces at the ordinary rate in the original table.
assignments.risk: No special failure or meltdown rule is documented for this pairing.

assignments.headline: Not yet assigned
assignments.outcome: Cortex Assembly is closed in the original simulation. Its opening belongs to the new story progression.
assignments.risk: Supervisor-specific outcomes are still to be designed.

assignments.headline: Redirects expertise
assignments.outcome: Reassigns workers toward the Brewery and skilled work in Weaving.
assignments.risk: Her preferred repair and research needs can empty another room.

assignments.headline: Repair, then restart
assignments.outcome: Spends available hours repairing before running the remaining shift.
assignments.risk: The repair is useful; its time still costs today’s output.

assignments.headline: Fixes the apparatus
assignments.outcome: Repairs first, then produces slowly. The art also explores incomprehensible and rebellious instruction.
assignments.risk: Those illustrated lecture failures are not dedicated outcomes in the original table.

assignments.headline: Her strongest room
assignments.outcome: Repairs first, then produces a normal or exceptional substrate batch.
assignments.risk: The original routine table has successes only; the experiment art belongs to a different escalation.

assignments.headline: Tomorrow over today
assignments.outcome: Repairs and prepares a later boost instead of producing ribbon today.
assignments.risk: A quota judged only on this shift makes preparation look like failure.

assignments.headline: Not yet assigned
assignments.outcome: Cortex Assembly is closed in the original simulation. Its opening belongs to the new story progression.
assignments.risk: Supervisor-specific outcomes are still to be designed.

assignments.headline: Relaxes the checkpoint
assignments.outcome: Assignment becomes unpredictable; a failed watch increases absence.
assignments.risk: The art shows an alarm disabled while guards lose focus.

assignments.headline: Slows the rhythm
assignments.outcome: Produces slowly while reducing factory stress.
assignments.risk: Relief comes with an immediate throughput cost.

assignments.headline: A different kind of session
assignments.outcome: The art presents a relaxed gathering and a musical counterweight to instruction.
assignments.risk: No dedicated Theatre outcome branch exists for Thrum in the original table.

assignments.headline: The batch becomes a break
assignments.outcome: Produces no substrate while sharply reducing stress and discipline.
assignments.risk: The crew drinks together; relief undermines the production plan.

assignments.headline: Restores the room
assignments.outcome: Repairs its equipment and prepares a stronger next shift, with no output today.
assignments.risk: High confidence here can turn restoration into Harmonic Dissolution.

assignments.headline: Not yet assigned
assignments.outcome: Cortex Assembly is closed in the original simulation. Its opening belongs to the new story progression.
assignments.risk: Supervisor-specific outcomes are still to be designed.

relationships.title: Permission versus result
relationships.dynamic: Limen can block the shortcut Stiletto needs. Backing either one changes who can overrule the other.
relationships.proposal: A restart becomes a contest over who controls the line.

relationships.title: Protocol versus persuasion
relationships.dynamic: He controls access; she controls the room’s attention. Each can weaken the other’s authority.
relationships.proposal: A compliance dispute becomes a public challenge to the approved message.

relationships.title: Authorization versus repair
relationships.dynamic: Her undocumented corrections are his evidence of noncompliance. He can stop the work that keeps his factory viable.
relationships.proposal: A successful repair is held until she submits to his process.

relationships.title: Discipline versus relief
relationships.dynamic: Thrum’s dissolution reduces Limen’s loyalty in the original rules. Relief weakens the order Limen enforces.
relationships.proposal: Limen tries to restore discipline while Thrum refuses to end recovery.

relationships.title: Pace versus preparation
relationships.dynamic: Stiletto sees delay; Cathexis sees unfinished minds. Their adjacent work can become an open dispute.
relationships.proposal: A batch is ready for the schedule and unready for the theatre.

relationships.title: Restart versus repair
relationships.dynamic: Witch inherits the damage Stiletto’s speed creates. Both can make a credible claim to saving the shift.
relationships.proposal: The first jam: inspect the line or force the restart.

relationships.title: Speed versus recovery
relationships.dynamic: One gains output by pushing; the other trades output for relief and preparation.
relationships.proposal: A restart order collides with a recovery session that has not ended.

relationships.title: Craft becomes influence
relationships.dynamic: They respect living patterns. Witch’s System Refactor also raises Cathexis’s confidence in the original rules.
relationships.proposal: A technical intervention gives Cathexis an audience for a new interpretation.

relationships.title: Two ways to move a crowd
relationships.dynamic: Thrum’s dissolution raises Cathexis’s influence. His atmosphere and her message can reinforce—or compete with—each other.
relationships.proposal: They disagree over whether the workforce needs a message or release from one.

relationships.title: Correction and verification
relationships.dynamic: She tunes the machinery; he hears what changed. Their established affinity supports repair and dangerous discovery alike.
relationships.proposal: A promising correction produces a resonance neither expected.
